default.content: In a survey of 120 transport management system rollouts, 64% finished later than planned. Master data problems were the most common cause, cited by 41% of teams.

default.title: Carrier onboarding costs
default.content: Teams that standardised carrier data before go-live reported 30% fewer post-launch defects than teams that cleaned data during the project.
